title: A Unified Perspective on Conformal Prediction and Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Optimization for Uncertainty Quantification
abstract: arXiv:2608.29789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Uncertainty quantification from finite data is central to machine learning, optimization, and automation systems, where decisions must remain reliable under limited samples and test-time distribution shift. Conformal prediction (CP) and distributionally robust optimization (DRO) offer two complementary approaches: CP constructs data-dependent prediction sets with distribution-free finite-sample validity under exchangeability, while DRO optimizes worst-case performance over an ambiguity set around an empirical distribution. We develop a unified probabilistic perspective on CP and DRO by viewing both as ways to turn finite calibration data into a data-dependent quantile estimator that a test score falls below with high probability. translated_title: 共形预测与Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化在不确定性量化中的统一视角
translated_abstract: 基于有限数据的不确定性量化是机器学习、优化和自动化系统的核心问题，在这些系统中，决策必须在样本有限以及测试时存在分布偏移的情况下保持可靠。共形预测（CP）和分布鲁棒优化（DRO）提供了两种互补的方法：CP在可交换性假设下构建具有无分布有限样本有效性的数据相关预测集，而DRO则在围绕经验分布构建的模糊集上优化最坏情况下的性能。我们通过将两者都视为把有限校准数据转化为数据相关分位数估计器的方式——该估计器以高概率保证测试分数低于其值——为CP和DRO建立了一个统一的概率视角。从这个视角出发，CP和DRO是沿着同一估计器族的两个坐标对经验分位数进行校正：CP提高分位数水平，而DRO则通过模糊集移动分位数值……
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的概率视角，将共形预测和Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化视为把有限校准数据转化为数据相关分位数估计器的两种方式——CP通过提高分位数水平进行校正，而DRO通过模糊集移动分位数值进行校正。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified probabilistic perspective that views conformal prediction and Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization as two ways of turning finite calibration data into data-dependent quantile estimators, where CP inflates the quantile level while DRO shifts the quantile value through an ambiguity set.
